exceptions.title: hands off hover between detached triggers when the rendered component retains a stale ref
exceptions.reason: The case renders a component that keeps the first ref callback that it got. A part gives its ref callbacks one time, in `setup`, and the callback of a trigger only writes the element to a ref. A watcher on the element, the id and the store then registers the trigger on the store that it has at that time. A callback that a component keeps thus cannot register the trigger on the store that the trigger left.

exceptions.title: keeps registration on the attached store when a stale-ref component swaps its host node
exceptions.reason: The case renders a component that keeps the first ref callback that it got, and swaps its host node. A part gives its ref callbacks one time, in `setup`, and the callback of a trigger only writes the element to a ref. The watcher of the registration then moves the registration to the new element on the store that the trigger has at that time.

exceptions.title: does not detach the consumer ref when the handle attaches to a root
exceptions.reason: The case counts the calls of the ref callback of a consumer. Base UI merges that callback with the ref callbacks of the part. A new merged ref for a change of the store would give the consumer a call with `null` and a new call, and the case guards against it. A part gives its own ref callbacks one time, in `setup`, and Vue does not merge the ref of a consumer with them. A change of the store thus changes no ref.

surfaceAdditions.reason: The part reads `disabled` for its state and for `useButton`, so it is a declared prop. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the trigger, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.

The part reads `id` to give it to its element, or a generated id when `id` is absent, so it is a declared prop. The popup names the `id` that the element has in `aria-labelledby`. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the title, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.

returnTypeDifferences.reason: `Popover.Handle` is the class `PopoverHandle`. The declaration of the function names the class, and Base UI documents the same class by its name in the namespace.
